description: This file defines constants and a function related to Extended Key Usage (EKU) OIDs used in X.509 certificates, including specific OIDs for server authentication, client authentication, code signing, email protection, timestamping, OCSP signing, and Netscape Gated Crypto. It also declares a function to parse EKU extensions.

methods.name: ParseEKUExtension
methods.description: Parses the extension value of an X.509 Extended Key Usage extension and populates a vector with DER-encoded OID values. Returns false if the encoding is invalid.
